title: Projects
text:
2 vs 2 Tennis (2018)
Four populations evolve separately for the upper-left, lower-left, upper-right, and lower-right player roles. Each generation evaluates all role combinations, assigning fitness per player based on points won across all evaluations, and then replays the best team matchup visually.
